claim: Neural and genetic methods consume most computation
originalWording: Neural and genetic methods consume most computation

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Neural networks and genetic algorithms account for more than half of computing work across the intended general computing population.
reference.rationale: Important neural successes by 2019 did not establish majority use across all computation. AI compute has become a major workload, but a global majority depends on the population and unit of work. The directional expansion is substantial; the literal aggregate threshold is not established.
